title: Herdr agent-agnostic orchestrator (herd mode)
description: Orchestrate ticks epics through Herdr panes/worktrees with heterogeneous agent fleets (any of herdr's 21 agent kinds as workers), while keeping harness-native orchestration as a configurable/auto-detected fallback. Spec: docs/design/herdr-orchestrator.md. Exploration: repo-wiki/herdr-orchestrator-exploration.md. Three epics: adapter conventions -> helper CLI -> mission-control plugin.
